# Spektor & Associates P.C.

> New York personal injury law firm specializing in automobile accidents, construction injuries, and negligence claims with experienced trial attorneys serving the tri-state area.

Spektor & Associates P.C. is a full-service personal injury law firm based in New York with a team of accomplished trial lawyers including Gregory Spektor (Top 100 National Trial Lawyer) and multiple Super Lawyers-recognized attorneys. The firm represents clients throughout New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, and Pennsylvania in motor vehicle accidents, construction accidents, premises liability, and medical malpractice cases.
